mobilenet_v3_small.size_reduction_explanation: MobileViT-XS contains 57.7% of its parameters in nn.Linear layers within its Transformer blocks, yielding a 41.7% checkpoint size reduction. In contrast, MobileNetV3-Small, EfficientNet-Lite0, and YOLOv8n-cls are pure CNN models with 98.6%-99.1% of parameters in nn.Conv2d layers; since quantize_dynamic targeted only nn.Linear, their Conv2d weights remained FP32 resulting in negligible size change.
